syncSwitch: One owner switch, published by the server (flags.syncV2 in api/auth.php?action=me and api/v2/entitlements.php, from api/lib/flags.php; off until api/flags.local.php says true or the default is changed and pushed). The website copies it to the browser, the app hands it to the page it shows (SBApp.setAuth no longer forces sync on) and uses it for its own saved items; with it off nothing is sent and no request is made for items, exactly as for the website's coins, plans and Tests Preps. The app's own coin steps are the one exception: the app has no older endpoint to fall back to, so it always sends them through api/v2/sync.php (the server accepts both generations of client into the same tables).
ownerDecisions: Switch client sync on (create api/flags.local.php on the server with <?php return ["syncV2" => true]; after the live checks of RELEASE_AND_ROLLBACK.md section 3). Until then bookmarks, notes and the reading position stay on each device, on both platforms.

Show Play Group / Nursery / KG in the app as coming-soon cards, and supply the missing Class 1 Urdu, Class 1 GK and Class 3 Urdu scans (catalogExemptions).
